expectations.text: A .docx study document was produced and opens cleanly (LibreOffice converts it)
A .pptx deck was produced and opens cleanly (LibreOffice converts it)
The document is detailed: at least 6000 words
The document is well structured: at least 20 headings
The document covers ≥ 95% of the source's key concepts (27 checked)
The document has at least 20 practice questions (enough to self-test for an exam)
Answers are in a separate answer-key section after the questions (so the learner can self-test)

expectations.text: The document includes flashcards for spaced review
The document includes a cheat sheet / one-page summary
The document has a glossary / key-terms section
The document flags common mistakes / pitfalls

expectations.text: The document gives exam tips
The document contains worked examples (≥ 4 mentions of example)
The document uses tables (comparison / summary) — at least 2
The deck is a reviewable size for flipping through: 15–45 slides
At least 90% of slides have speaker notes
No slide has text that overflows its box or shapes outside the slide
The deck includes practice/quiz questions
The document is written in Persian (Persian script dominates the text)
